criteria.requirement: Implement bidict.select.select(mapping, *, keys=None, values=None, predicate=None, strict=False). Combine requested key/value/predicate filters, distinguish absent filters from empty selections, retain original relative order and concrete bidict/frozen/ordered/custom type and inverse behavior. One-shot filters are consumed once. Strict missing requests raise before callbacks, callbacks propagate normally and result backing must be independent of source mutation.

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
